defense_news.title: US Air Force buys final KC-46 lot under Boeing’s original tanker deal
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon announced a $2.82 billion Boeing contract for 15 more KC-46A Pegasus tankers, the final production lot under the program's original 2011 contract.

defense_news.title: Japan to use Indian ranges for long-range missile training under new pact
defense_news.summary: Japanese officials visited India in October to assess whether its missile ranges could accommodate training with anti-ship missiles and smaller attack drones.

defense_news.title: Czech jet engine maker eyes growing role as US supplier in drones, missiles
defense_news.summary: Czech jet engine producer PBS Aerospace aims to expand its manufacturing capacity in the United States, targeting at least a twofold increase in its production capacity there.
